standard_prerequisites.name: Ramification indices are multiplicative in towers of discrete valuation rings
standard_prerequisites.use: Combines e = 1 at each step to e = 1 for M/K.

core_obligations: Let C be the integral closure of A in M; every maximal ideal m' of C contracts to a maximal ideal m of B (proof lines 33147-33149). At m' the ramification index of the local extension over A is the product of the ramification index of C_m over B_m and that of B_m over A, both equal to 1 by the unramifiedness hypotheses, so the multiplicative-e-f lemma gives ramification index 1 (proof lines 33150-33151). The residue field of C at m' is a finite extension of the residue field of A, factoring through the finite extensions kappa(m')/kappa(m)/kappa_A whose steps are trivial by the hypotheses, so the total residue extension is trivial and M/K is unramified with respect to A (proof lines 33152-33154).
proof_roadmap: Relate the primes of C to those of B (proof lines 33147-33149).
Multiply ramification indices and compose the residue field tower (proof lines 33150-33154).
